title: Reckoner (v2)
description: Institutional paper-and-wine: a deep merlot first screen, linen paper with charcoal text, white cards, sand buttons and hairlines, a tan emphasis colour and a crimson accent kept for small marks. One neo-grotesk (Mona Sans) at regular weight, big jumps in size, square corners, no shadows.
notes: light is the faithful mode; dark is a warm near-black sibling with a merlot-brown hero
primary is the merlot surface (hero, button hover); secondary is the sand button fill; glow carries the crimson accent
Mona Sans is the original's own open-licence face; section spacing and gutter are clamp()s (≈88px/20px on phones, 144px/50px at 1440)
